metadata.name: SoRLa Designer
metadata.summary: Author and update SoRLa systems-of-record from a guided prompt session.
metadata.description: Author and update SoRLa systems-of-record from a guided prompt session.

tools.name: parse_sorla_yaml
tools.description: Parse sorla.yaml into a stable design model. Returns the normalized model, diagnostics, and the source hash.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The full sorla.yaml document source text."},"source_path":{"type":"string","description":"Optional path the YAML came from; used for diagnostics only."}},"required":["source_yaml"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: generate_concept_view
tools.description: Generate a presentation-neutral concept view from sorla.yaml. Returns the concept view plus parse diagnostics.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The full sorla.yaml document source text."},"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["overview","review","edit","cli","designer"],"default":"designer","description":"Concept-view rendering mode."},"renderer_capabilities":{"type":"object","description":"What the caller's renderer can draw. Omit to use the built-in defaults.","properties":{"cards":{"type":"boolean"},"tables":{"type":"boolean"},"graphs":{"type":"boolean"},"forms":{"type":"boolean"},"charts":{"type":"boolean"},"cli_tables":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["cards","tables","graphs","forms","charts","cli_tables"]}},"required":["source_yaml"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: apply_sorla_patch
tools.description: Apply a semantic patch to sorla.yaml and return diff plus refreshed view. Returns the updated YAML, old/new hashes, diagnostics, the concept diff, and the refreshed concept view.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The full sorla.yaml document source text."},"patch":{"type":"object","description":"A greentic.sorla.patch.v1 semantic patch document.","properties":{"schema":{"type":"string","const":"greentic.sorla.patch.v1"},"source":{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["sorla-yaml"]},"path":{"type":"string"},"base_hash":{"type":"string","description":"Hash of the sorla.yaml the patch was authored against."}},"required":["kind","base_hash"]},"author":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string"},"kind":{"type":"string"}}},"intent":{"type":"string","description":"Human-readable intent of the patch."},"operations":{"type":"array","description":"Ordered patch operations; each is tagged by its `op` discriminator.","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"op":{"type":"string","enum":["add_record","rename_record","delete_record","add_field","update_field","remove_field"]},"record":{"description":"Record name for add_field / update_field / remove_field; the record object for add_record."},"name":{"type":"string","description":"Target name for delete_record / update_field / remove_field."},"from":{"type":"string","description":"rename_record: current record name."},"to":{"type":"string","description":"rename_record: new record name."},"field":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"type":{"type":"string","description":"Field type name."},"i18n_key":{"type":"string"},"required":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"sensitive":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"enum_values":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["name","type"],"description":"add_field: the field to add."},"type_name":{"type":"string","description":"update_field: new field type."},"required":{"type":"boolean","description":"update_field: new required flag."},"sensitive":{"type":"boolean","description":"update_field: new sensitive flag."},"enum_values":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["op"]}}},"required":["schema","source","operations"]}},"required":["source_yaml","patch"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: propose_patch_from_instruction
tools.description: Ask an LLM capability to propose a semantic SoRLa patch. Returns the proposed patch, an explanation, risks, and a preview diff; it does not modify the source.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The full sorla.yaml document source text."},"instruction":{"type":"string","description":"Natural-language description of the change to propose."},"llm":{"type":"object","description":"LLM capability seam. Omit to let the host resolve the declared `sorla_composer` role.","properties":{"provider":{"type":"string","description":"Provider id; use \"host\" to delegate to the designer host."},"model":{"type":"string"},"endpoint":{"type":"string"},"capability_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["provider"]}},"required":["source_yaml","instruction"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: validate_sorla_yaml
tools.description: Validate sorla.yaml and return diagnostics. Returns `valid` (false when any diagnostic has severity "error") and the diagnostic list.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The full sorla.yaml document source text."},"source_path":{"type":"string","description":"Optional path the YAML came from; used for diagnostics only."}},"required":["source_yaml"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: plan_gtpack_from_sorla_yaml
tools.description: Plan deterministic .gtpack entries from sorla.yaml for host packaging. Returns the pack entry metadata; the host performs the actual archiving.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The full sorla.yaml document source text."},"pack_name":{"type":"string","description":"Pack id to stamp; used as a fallback when sorla.yaml declares no package."},"pack_version":{"type":"string","description":"Pack version to stamp; used as a fallback when sorla.yaml declares no package."},"include_content":{"type":"boolean","default":false,"description":"When true each entry also carries its raw bytes as base64 `content_base64` so the host can ZIP directly."}},"required":["source_yaml","pack_name","pack_version"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: generate_model_from_prompt
tools.description: Generate a deterministic Sorla model draft from a prompt. Returns the normalized model with validation diagnostics and a preview.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"prompt":{"type":"string","description":"Business description of the system of record to draft. Must not be empty."},"constraints":{"type":"object","description":"Which optional model sections to include in the draft.","properties":{"include_ontology":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"include_agent_endpoints":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"include_retrieval_bindings":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"additionalProperties":false},"draft_json":{"description":"Optional existing draft to seed generation (any JSON value)."}},"required":["prompt"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: validate_model
tools.description: Validate a Sorla model and return diagnostics plus preview.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"model":{"type":"object","description":"A normalized SoRLa model (greentic_sorla_lib::NormalizedSorlaModel).","properties":{"package_name":{"type":"string"},"package_version":{"type":"string"},"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47-ish locale tag, e.g. \"en\"."},"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The sorla.yaml source the model was normalized from."},"normalized_answers":{"description":"Normalized wizard answers document (any JSON value)."}},"required":["package_name","package_version","locale","source_yaml","normalized_answers"]}},"required":["model"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: improve_model
tools.description: Apply deterministic improvements to a Sorla model draft. Returns the validated model plus a `changes` list recording the instruction.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"model":{"type":"object","description":"A normalized SoRLa model (greentic_sorla_lib::NormalizedSorlaModel).","properties":{"package_name":{"type":"string"},"package_version":{"type":"string"},"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47-ish locale tag, e.g. \"en\"."},"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The sorla.yaml source the model was normalized from."},"normalized_answers":{"description":"Normalized wizard answers document (any JSON value)."}},"required":["package_name","package_version","locale","source_yaml","normalized_answers"]},"instruction":{"type":"string","description":"Natural-language improvement instruction to record against the model."}},"required":["model","instruction"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: explain_model
tools.description: Explain the Sorla model as structured sections. Returns a summary sentence, preview cards as `sections`, and the full preview.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"model":{"type":"object","description":"A normalized SoRLa model (greentic_sorla_lib::NormalizedSorlaModel).","properties":{"package_name":{"type":"string"},"package_version":{"type":"string"},"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47-ish locale tag, e.g. \"en\"."},"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The sorla.yaml source the model was normalized from."},"normalized_answers":{"description":"Normalized wizard answers document (any JSON value)."}},"required":["package_name","package_version","locale","source_yaml","normalized_answers"]}},"required":["model"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: generate_gtpack
tools.description: Generate deterministic Sorla pack-entry metadata from a normalized model. Provide exactly one of `model` (already normalized) or `answers` (a completed prompt-session answers document); the explicit `package` coordinates always win over any coordinates inside `answers`.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"model":{"type":"object","description":"A pre-normalized model. Mutually exclusive with `answers`.","properties":{"package_name":{"type":"string"},"package_version":{"type":"string"},"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47-ish locale tag, e.g. \"en\"."},"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The sorla.yaml source the model was normalized from."},"normalized_answers":{"description":"Normalized wizard answers document (any JSON value)."}},"required":["package_name","package_version","locale","source_yaml","normalized_answers"]},"answers":{"description":"A completed prompt-session answers document, normalized here. Mutually exclusive with `model`."},"package":{"type":"object","description":"Pack coordinates to stamp onto the generated entries.","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"version":{"type":"string"}},"required":["name","version"],"additionalProperties":false},"options":{"type":"object","properties":{"include_validation_metadata":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"include_designer_preview":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"additionalProperties":false},"include_content":{"type":"boolean","default":false,"description":"When true each entry also carries its raw bytes as base64 `content_base64`."}},"required":["package"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: start_prompt_session
tools.description: Start an interactive prompt-to-answers authoring session. Call with no arguments to open a greenfield session, with `business_prompt` to take the first turn immediately, or with `existing_sorla_yaml` plus `business_prompt` to author an update to an existing package.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"business_prompt":{"type":"string","description":"Business description to take the first turn with. Required when `existing_sorla_yaml` is set."},"existing_sorla_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"Current sorla.yaml to update instead of authoring greenfield. Must declare a package name and version."},"locale":{"type":"string"},"schema_version":{"type":"string"},"package_name_hint":{"type":"string"},"package_version_hint":{"type":"string"},"llm":{"type":"object","description":"LLM capability seam. Omit to let the host resolve the declared `sorla_composer` role.","properties":{"provider":{"type":"string","description":"Provider id; use \"host\" to delegate to the designer host."},"model":{"type":"string"},"endpoint":{"type":"string"},"capability_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["provider"]}},"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: continue_prompt_session
tools.description: Advance an interactive prompt-to-answers authoring session. Pass the `session` returned by the previous turn unchanged, plus the user's reply.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"session":{"type":"object","description":"The `session` object returned verbatim by start_prompt_session / continue_prompt_session. Pass it back unchanged; do not synthesize it.","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"phase":{"type":"string","enum":["awaiting-business-prompt","extracting-domain-model","reviewing-domain-model","asking-targeted-questions","compiling-expanded-plan","reviewing-expanded-plan","generating-answers","asking-questions","reviewing-design-plan","ready-to-generate-answers","completed"]}},"required":["session_id","phase"],"additionalProperties":true},"user_message":{"type":"string","description":"The user's reply for this turn."}},"required":["session","user_message"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: generate_prompt_answers
tools.description: Generate wizard answers JSON from a completed prompt session. Pass the `session` from the last turn; update sessions are stamped with flow "update" and the original package coordinates.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"session":{"type":"object","description":"The `session` object returned verbatim by start_prompt_session / continue_prompt_session. Pass it back unchanged; do not synthesize it.","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"phase":{"type":"string","enum":["awaiting-business-prompt","extracting-domain-model","reviewing-domain-model","asking-targeted-questions","compiling-expanded-plan","reviewing-expanded-plan","generating-answers","asking-questions","reviewing-design-plan","ready-to-generate-answers","completed"]}},"required":["session_id","phase"],"additionalProperties":true}},"required":["session"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: list_designer_node_types
tools.description: List Designer node types generated from SoRLa agent endpoints.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"model":{"type":"object","description":"A normalized SoRLa model (greentic_sorla_lib::NormalizedSorlaModel).","properties":{"package_name":{"type":"string"},"package_version":{"type":"string"},"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47-ish locale tag, e.g. \"en\"."},"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The sorla.yaml source the model was normalized from."},"normalized_answers":{"description":"Normalized wizard answers document (any JSON value)."}},"required":["package_name","package_version","locale","source_yaml","normalized_answers"]},"component_ref":{"type":"string","default":"oci://ghcr.io/greenticai/components/component-sorx-business:stable","description":"Component reference bound into the generated node types."},"operation":{"type":"string","default":"invoke_locked_action","description":"Component operation bound into the generated node types."}},"required":["model"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: generate_flow_node_from_node_type
tools.description: Generate a generic flow node from a locked SoRLa Designer node type. Select the node type by exactly one of `node_type_id`, `endpoint_id`, or `label`; every required endpoint input must appear in `value_mappings` or the call returns diagnostics.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"model":{"type":"object","description":"A normalized SoRLa model (greentic_sorla_lib::NormalizedSorlaModel).","properties":{"package_name":{"type":"string"},"package_version":{"type":"string"},"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47-ish locale tag, e.g. \"en\"."},"source_yaml":{"type":"string","description":"The sorla.yaml source the model was normalized from."},"normalized_answers":{"description":"Normalized wizard answers document (any JSON value)."}},"required":["package_name","package_version","locale","source_yaml","normalized_answers"]},"step_id":{"type":"string","description":"Flow step id for the generated node."},"node_type_id":{"type":"string","description":"Exact Designer node type id."},"endpoint_id":{"type":"string","description":"SoRLa agent endpoint id to resolve to one node type."},"label":{"type":"string","description":"Node type label to resolve to one node type."},"value_mappings":{"type":"object","description":"Endpoint input name -> value expression. Must cover every required input.","additionalProperties":{"type":"string"}},"component_ref":{"type":"string","default":"oci://ghcr.io/greenticai/components/component-sorx-business:stable","description":"Component reference bound into the generated node types."},"operation":{"type":"string","default":"invoke_locked_action","description":"Component operation bound into the generated node types."}},"required":["model","step_id"],"additionalProperties":false}
